_readme: Bonds between the ladies: a value from -100 (bitter rivals) to 100 (inseparable), plus an optional kind for special relationships.
Named ladies start with the bonds listed under 'bonds' in characters.json. Everyone else starts at 0 and drifts while they share a house (see drift).
labels: how a bond shows on her sheet. kinds: special relationships (mentor is one-way: the lady who lists it mentors the other).
events: things that happen between two ladies. shared: scenes where two ladies spend the night with Sam. Both use the same format:

a / b: requirements for each lady: devoted (true/false), trustMin, lewdMin, moodMin, moodBelow, lustMin, energyBelow / energyAbove (share of max energy), working (not resting), intimate (comfortable with private time with Sam).
bondMin / bondMax / kind: requirements on their bond (kind 'mentor' means a mentors b). sameHouse defaults to true. weight = how often it's picked among eligible ones.
title / text use {a} and {b} for their names; text can be a list to pick from. scene = image scene (shown for a). ai = prompt key from ai-prompts.json for the ✨ button.
choices: label, res (result text), and effects: a / b {mood, trust, lewd, lust, energy, popularity, grow:{service:3}, lesson:true (b improves at a's best service)},

bond (change), gold, rep, samEnergy, sam:{technique:2}, private:["a","b"] (counts as private time with Sam for them), roll:0.5 with else:{...} (a coin flip), needsGold (choice only offered if Sam can pay).

events.title: {b} Covers for {a}
text: {a} is dead on her feet. {b} has already offered to take her clients tonight, and is now looking at Sam for permission.

choices.label: Let her
choices.res: {a} sleeps for twelve hours. She brings {b} breakfast in bed the next morning.

choices.label: Send them both to bed
choices.res: The house runs a little short tonight. Neither of them complains.

events.title: A Night Out
text: {a} and {b} want a night off together: the night market, too much wine, and absolutely no clients. They'd love it if Sam paid.

choices.label: Cover the tab (40g)
choices.res: They come back at dawn arm in arm, singing, with a souvenir for Sam that he does not understand.

choices.label: They can go on their own coin
choices.res: They go anyway. They have a wonderful time and don't bring Sam anything.

events.title: {a} and {b} Are at It Again
text: The shouting in the kitchen is about a missing hairbrush. It is not really about the hairbrush.
{a} and {b} have stopped speaking to each other and started speaking through the other girls, which is worse.

choices.label: Sit them both down
choices.res: It takes an hour and a pot of tea, but by the end they're grudgingly laughing about it.

else.res: It ends with both of them storming out of different doors. Progress, of a sort.

choices.label: Split up their shifts
choices.res: They see less of each other. It helps a little.

choices.label: Let them sort it out
choices.res: They have it out in the yard. Afterward they're sharing a bottle on the steps like nothing happened.

else.res: They have it out in the yard. Nobody wins. The hairbrush is never found.

events.title: A Stolen Client
text: {a} insists {b} stole one of her regulars on purpose. {b} insists he just has taste.

choices.label: Side with {a}
choices.res: {a} is vindicated. {b} is going to remember this.

choices.label: Side with {b}
choices.res: {b} smirks. {a} is going to remember this.

choices.label: "He can see you both"
choices.res: The client is thrilled. The two of them are less thrilled, but the money's good.

events.title: {a} Takes {b} Under Her Wing
text: {a} has noticed {b} struggling with some of the finer points of the work, and offers to teach her.

choices.label: Pay for proper lessons (30g)
choices.res: A week of lessons. {b} carries herself differently by the end of it.

choices.label: Let them work it out
choices.res: {a} teaches between shifts. {b} picks up a few tricks.

events.title: A Taste of Home
text: {a} and {b} have spent all afternoon trying to recreate a dish from back home with ingredients that are almost, but not quite, right. They want Sam to judge.

choices.label: "It's perfect"
choices.res: It is not perfect. It's close enough that all three of them go quiet for a minute.

choices.label: Be honest
choices.res: "Needs soy sauce," Sam says. They both groan. They spend the next week trying to invent soy sauce.

events.title: Two of a Kind
text: {a} and {b} have started finishing each other's sentences. The other girls find it unsettling. The clients find it charming.

choices.label: Book them as a pair
choices.res: Word gets around. They're the talk of the house.

choices.label: Leave them be
choices.res: They're happy. That's enough.

shared.title: A Knock, Twice
text: There's a knock at Sam's door. It's {a}. Then a second knock: {b}, right behind her. They look at each other, then at Sam, and seem to reach an understanding without him.

choices.label: Let them both in
choices.res: Nobody gets much sleep. (Sam's energy −30)

choices.label: "One at a time, please"
choices.res: They exchange a look, decide he's adorable, and agree to take turns. Sam is not sure he won anything.

shared.title: Who Does He Like Best?
text: {a} and {b} have decided to settle their rivalry the obvious way, and Sam is the obvious judge. Neither of them is willing to leave first.

choices.label: Refuse to pick a winner
choices.res: It is a very long night. By morning they've called it a draw, and they're looking at each other with something like respect. (Sam's energy −40)

else.res: It is a very long night. Both of them leave convinced they won and furious the other one thinks so too. (Sam's energy −40)

choices.label: Send them both away
choices.res: They leave together, united for once, in being annoyed with Sam.

shared.title: {a} Brings a Friend
text: {a} shows up at Sam's door with {b} in tow. "She's been curious," {a} says. {b} goes pink, but doesn't deny it.

choices.label: Invite them in
choices.res: {b} looks at Sam differently afterward. So does {a}, come to think of it. (Sam's energy −30)

choices.label: "Maybe another time"
choices.res: {b} laughs it off, a little relieved and a little disappointed.

shared.title: A Practical Lesson
text: {a} has been teaching {b} the finer points of the work, and has decided theory only goes so far. She'd like to borrow Sam for a demonstration.

choices.label: Volunteer
choices.res: {b} is a quick study. {a} is a demanding teacher. Sam is a very tired visual aid. (Sam's energy −25)

choices.label: "I have paperwork"
choices.res: {a} sighs. "Fine. We'll use a pillow."

shared.title: Room for One More
text: {a} and {b} are soaking in the bath after a long week, and they've noticed Sam walking past the door for the third time. "Oh, just get in."

choices.label: Get in
choices.res: Mostly they talk. Mostly. Sam comes out pink and more relaxed than he's been in weeks. (Sam's energy +10)

choices.label: Keep walking
choices.res: Their laughter follows him down the hall.
